description:
### Ekşi Morphe (v0.1.7)

* **Relative entry timestamps**: New patch. Entries younger than 48 hours show their age next to the date, for example "21.11.2026 11:12 · 12 sa 3 dk". Older entries show only the date. You can turn this patch off in Morphe Manager.

Supports Ekşi Sözlük 2.5.1.
